title: DSP loader
author: irpina
description: DSP code at run time for the Octatrack: a mod hands its DSP code to ot_dsp_load, or lists it in mod.json's dsp_load (the SDK puts it in the ot_dsp_blobs table, which TELOS mods from the card can add to), and from the next audio frames it runs on DSP core 0 as an ev_dsp_rx handler. The code goes into the DSP window's clear gap (597 words), sent to DSP core 1 over the host port and copied there by a copier that takes SPATIALIZER's code space on core 1 (after sambanks/octabam's demand loader, MIT). From 0.2 a guard word at each end of the code, checked before it runs, stops it for good if a reverb's buffer reaches it. Needs the DSP bus.
